title: ebenus
intro: Ebenus, commonly known as the rose of Jericho or resurrection plant, is a type of flowering plant native to the Middle East and North Africa. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Ebenus include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it useful for stress relief and promoting relaxation. Bioactive constituents of Ebenus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
